description.zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式。
description.en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the Cloud Backup client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault.

description.zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名。
description.en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
- **SELF_ACCOUNT**：本账号备份
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT**：跨账号备份
description.en:
The backup type. Valid values:

- **SELF_ACCOUNT**: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
- **CROSS_ACCOUNT**: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

description.zh: 要注册的HANA系统的所有节点（实例ID），备份服务将在这些节点中安装备份客户端。
description.en: The IDs of the ECS instances that host the SAP HANA instance to be registered. Cloud Backup installs backup clients on the specified ECS instances.
The name of the SAP HANA instance.

description.zh: SAP HANA主节点的私有或内网IP地址。
description.en: The private or internal IP address of the host where the primary node of the SAP HANA instance resides.

description.zh: 安装SAP HANA时指定的实例编号。
description.en: The instance number of the SAP HANA system.
The password that is used to connect with the SAP HANA database.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
SAP HANA数据库的SID。更多信息，请参见
[如何查找SID](https://answers.sap.com/questions/555192/how-to-find-sid-user-and-instance-number-of-hana-d.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.55c34b4ftZeXNK)。
description.en: The security identifier (SID) of the SAP HANA database. For more information, see [How to find sid user and instance number of HANA db?](https://answers.sap.com/questions/555192/how-to-find-sid-user-and-instance-number-of-hana-d.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.55c34b4ftZeXNK).

description.zh: 打开SSL连接开关，表示使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库。
description.en: Specifies whether to connect with the SAP HANA database over Secure Sockets Layer (SSL).
The username of the SYSTEMDB database.

description.zh: 打开验证SSL证书开关后，表示验证数据库服务端SSL证书。
description.en: Specifies whether to verify the SSL certificate of the SAP HANA database.
The ID of the backup vault.

descriptions.zh: 注册SAP HANA实例需要配置SAP HANA连接信息，实例注册完成后，云备份HBR将在SAP HANA实例节点上安装备份客户端。
descriptions.en: To register an SAP HANA instance, you must configure the SAP HANA connection information. After the SAP HANA instance is registered, Cloud Backup installs a backup client on the node of the SAP HANA instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr create-hana-instance --vault-id v-0003v4a000000gfv2 --hana-name HANA-DEV --host 47.100.XX.XX --instance-number 0 --user-name admin --password 000000000000 --use-ssl true --validate-certificate false --alert-setting INHERITED --ecs-instance-id i-uf6ir9y000000hvisj --sid HXE --resource-group-id rg-acfm4ebtpkzx7zy --cross-account-type CROSS_ACCOUNT --cross-account-user-id 1589754625 --cross-account-role-name hbrcrossrole --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr CreateHanaInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceNumber 0 --UserName admin --CrossAccountUserId 1589754625 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm4ebtpkzx7zy' --CrossAccountRoleName hbrcrossrole --CrossAccountType CROSS_ACCOUNT --Host '47.100.XX.XX' --UseSsl true --VaultId 'v-0003v4a000000gfv2' --Sid HXE --EcsInstanceId 'i-uf6ir9y000000hvisj' --HanaName 'HANA-DEV' --AlertSetting INHERITED --Password 000000000000 --ValidateCertificate false
